topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: I can scarce believe the nerve of that lad, Cormac, sending a gift to the master now he's gone off to town. As if the toil and care we poured into him, for him to just use his learning to better his own lot, and not give a thought to those left behind here. Still, a quill pen, they say it is; fine for writing, so it seems. 'Tis not as if we need such finery here, scratching out what little we have. Saints preserve us, the cheek of it. I hope it's served him right, finding a use for all the words we taught him, though I doubt he remembers the lessons on humility or the value of the earth under his feet.
